matching_validation.candidate_generation: Deterministic identifiers and declared normalized features generate candidates separately from acceptance decisions.

inter_rater.sampling_frame: All manually adjudicated pairs, reported overall and by prespecified M-090 dimension where cell size permits.
inter_rater.small_cell_rule: Suppress unstable stratum estimates and report counts.

negative_controls.construction: Pair ingredient-level and pack-level records without an exact declared bridge.
Pair records with unresolved mapping evidence.
Attempt to compare a regulatory assertion directly with a funding assertion.

conflicts.reporting: Report source, valid time, retrieval time, conflict class, and unresolved state; adjudication may qualify but never erase source evidence.

coverage_denominators.definition: All governed catalog source surfaces eligible under the prospective source-selection rules.
coverage_denominators.numerator: Eligible sources with a valid bounded retrieval or fixture receipt.

coverage_denominators.definition: All source-native entities in the declared lawful analysis extract.
coverage_denominators.numerator: Entities with the required outcome evidence for the stated analysis.

coverage_denominators.definition: All assertions eligible for the stated outcome and valid-time window.
coverage_denominators.numerator: Assertions with complete required provenance and semantic fields.

coverage_denominators.definition: All candidate comparisons evaluated under M-090.
coverage_denominators.numerator: Comparisons classified valid or valid_with_caveats; each state is also reported separately.

uncertainty.interval_method: Wilson 95 percent intervals for binomial proportions when meaningful; bootstrap intervals use the registered seed and resample at the source-native entity level.
uncertainty.small_cells: Report numerator and denominator and avoid unstable interval interpretation.
uncertainty.no_evidence_claim: Unavailable or incomplete evidence does not establish unapproved, unfunded, equivalent, or absent status.

descriptive.summary: Counts and proportions by source-native regulatory status, jurisdiction, entity granularity, indication, population, and valid-time window.
Counts and proportions by source-native funding status, jurisdiction, entity granularity, indication, population, and valid-time window.
Numerators and declared denominators for source, entity, assertion, field, temporal, and comparison coverage.
Counts and proportions for each M-090 validity state and material mismatch dimension.

sensitivity.variation: Restrict to exact entity mappings and overlapping valid-time intervals.
Restrict to sources with current live qualification receipts, then compare with governed-fixture results.
sensitivity.interpretation: Separates source availability from method behavior.

sensitivity.variation: Report unresolved conflicts as a separate stratum and exclude them in a secondary summary.
sensitivity.interpretation: Bounds sensitivity to conflict handling without overwriting evidence.

sensitivity.variation: Compare complete-case descriptive summaries with explicit missingness strata; do not impute status.
sensitivity.interpretation: Shows the effect of observable missingness without treating absence as a negative.

sensitivity.variation: Repeat eligible summaries at ingredient and source-native product granularities where valid mappings exist.
sensitivity.interpretation: Assesses dependence on unit of analysis.
